subject: general
question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no.1.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Nutrients**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Nutrients **refer to the substances that provide nourishment to living organisms. (पोषण प्रदान करें)

 
 
• **Example**: *Fruits and vegetables are rich sources of essential nutrients, such as vitamins and minerals.*
 
 
 
• This option is the most appropriate because it fits the context of the sentence, which seems to be related to the upkeep of something (maintenance) that requires a supply of essential substances (**nutrients**).

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Maintenance **refers to the act of keeping something in good condition. (रखरखाव)
 
• **Ingredients **are the components used to make a particular dish or product. (सामग्री)
 
• **Items **refer to objects or things that are part of a collection or group. (सामान)

15c:T97a,
The correct answer is: Flourish</st
